note: Conceptual/practice lesson on structuring an integration design document, applying general integration-pattern concepts (request-reply, fire-and-forget, batch, event-driven) to Salesforce mechanisms (Apex callouts, Named Credentials, Platform Events). No screenshots used per this course's conceptual, no-screenshots policy. Named Credentials and Platform Events are well-established, already-public Salesforce platform features; no new unverifiable specific number or limit was asserted.
